# Vault instructions

This directory is one vault. Its kind is stated in the frontmatter of 00-project/brief.md and 00-project/voice.md; here it is `story`. Only kind story permits manuscript drafting; kind study permits study notes only; kind starter is an unused template.

Manuscript files follow 00-project/voice.md and nothing from documentation or didactic writing rules. Other vault notes are plain working notes. Replies to the author stay reader-oriented; the voice sheet never styles a reply.

files.01-world/overview.md:
# World overview

The salt-road courier guild has three ranks. A runner carries unsealed post inside one city. A courier carries sealed letters between cities and may refuse a commission. A warden keeps a gate ledger and settles disputes between couriers and clients.
